Description Disables routing of a group of PDUs in the So Ad related to the Routing Group specified by parameter id. Routing of PDUs can be either forwarding of PDUs from the upper layer to a TCP or UDP socket of the TCP/ IP stack specified by a Pdu Route or the other way around specified by a Socket Route. Available via So Ad.h
